35K views · 2K reactions | On 16 October 2026, the Ghana Armed Forces took delivery of 45 modern military pattern vehicles including 15 KIA utility, 15 four-by-four, and 15 six-by-six troop carriers ,advancing a massive national retooling drive across all frontiers. 

This land fleet follows the recent commissioning of the Navy's GNS PRU and the Air Force's new Airbus H175 helicopter, directly fulfilling the strategic vision of Commander-in-Chief, His Excellency John Dramani Mahama, to build a standard 21st-century defense force. 

Watch the clip below to see the new assets in action. | Ghana Armed Forces
